# Deepanshu Kapoor

> Freelance AI, full-stack and security engineer with 13+ years of experience.
> Builds and secures web applications, integrates AI/LLMs (including self-hosted
> models and RAG), removes website malware, and builds frontends for firewall and
> IDS/IPS security products. Acknowledged in the security researcher hall of fame
> by Microsoft, eBay, Red Hat and Sellfy. Works with clients worldwide; replies
> within an hour. Site: https://kapoordeepanshu.github.io/

## Services
- AI-integrated applications: OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, or self-hosted open-weight models via Ollama/vLLM; retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings, FastAPI backends.
- Full-stack web development: React, Angular, Next.js, Node.js, PHP, Laravel — architecture through deployment.
- Secure web development: OWASP Top 10, input validation, authentication, access control, pre-launch security review.
- Website malware removal & hardening: clean compromised sites, close the entry point, harden the server.
- WordPress, Magento & OpenCart security: audits, malware cleanup, hardening.
- Ecommerce development: Shopify, Magento, BigCommerce, OpenCart.
- CI/CD pipeline design: GitHub Actions build/test/deploy on merge.
- Security product frontends: firewall and IDS/IPS interfaces (Suricata).

## Tech stack
- AI: OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Ollama, vLLM, RAG, embeddings, FastAPI
- Frontend: React, Angular, Next.js, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3
- Backend: PHP, Laravel, CodeIgniter, Node.js, Python
- Databases: MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, GraphQL, REST
- Ecommerce/CMS: WordPress, Magento, Shopify, BigCommerce, OpenCart
- DevOps & security: AWS, Docker, Linux, Nginx, GitHub Actions, OWASP, Suricata IDS/IPS
